title: Observation equals encoded row bit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$ whose work-tape heads lie in the window of radius $s$ and whose tapes are blank outside that window. Then the Boolean observation of $c$ at every encoded bit position agrees with the corresponding bit in the encoded row of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
$c$ is in the window of radius $s$
